steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided link and unzip it on your computer if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware files
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files (e.g., custom 12 mL tube rack).

steps.title: Upload Python protocol
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded .py protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the tube racks containing individual samples in deck slots 2 and 3, place empty 12 mL tubes for pooled samples in slot 5, and position the Visby device with its adapter on the slot indicated by the deck map.

substeps.instruction: Place source tube racks in slots 2 and 3.
Place empty 12 mL pooled‑sample tubes in slot 5.
Place the Visby device (with adapter) on the designated slot.

steps.title: Load pipette and tips
steps.instruction: Mount the P1000 Single‑Channel GEN2 pipette on the chosen mount (left or right) and load Opentrons 1000 µL filter tips.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, perform calibration for the source tube racks, pooled‑sample tube rack, Visby adapter, and the P1000 pipette according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Pool individual samples
steps.instruction: Transfer the calculated volume from each individual sample into the pooled‑sample tube according to the user‑specified parameters.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volume per sample: Total Volume of Pooled Samples ÷ Number of Samples per Pool (e.g., 500 µL ÷ 5 samples = 100 µL).
Aspirate the calculated volume from each individual sample tube in slots 2 and 3.
Dispense the aspirated volume into the corresponding pooled‑sample tube in slot 5.
Pool 1–5 samples per tube as specified by the Number of Samples per Pool (2‑5).

steps.title: Transfer pooled volume to Visby
steps.instruction: Aspirate the total pooled volume from each pooled‑sample tube and dispense it into the Visby device(s).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the user‑specified total pooled volume from each pooled‑sample tube in slot 5.
Dispense the aspirated volume into the inlet of each Visby device (up to the selected Number of Visbys, 1‑6).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the Opentrons App to execute the protocol on the OT‑2 robot.
